explain.what: A watched program or setting file changed: “/usr/bin/x”. Heimdall watches the security tools, the AI agents and their settings, because changing them is how an attack takes over.
explain.serious: For your information; nothing needs doing.
explain.done: Heimdall recorded it; nothing was changed on your computer.
explain.do: If you just installed updates or changed this file yourself, nothing to do. Otherwise reinstall the package it belongs to (pacman -Qo shows which) and check Settings > Security.
